mapper.sql: id, user_id, record_date, weight, bmi, source, remark, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO body_data ( user_id, record_date, weight, bmi, source, remark, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{recordDate}, #{weight}, #{bmi}, #{source}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE weight = VALUES(weight), bmi = VALUES(bmi), source = VALUES(source), remark = VALUES(remark), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM body_data WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND record_date = #{recordDate} LIMIT 1
